title: Blue Monkey Colossus
description: A giant blue monkey with white eyes and ornate golden patterns sits among ancient ruins. Its body is covered in intricate horizontal bands depicting miniature scenes of animals, skeletons, and landscapes, while smoke curls from its mouth and hands.
prompt: A colossal blue monkey with glowing white eyes and curling smoke from its nostrils and fingertips, seated in a misty landscape of classical ruins. Its body is wrapped in intricate horizontal golden bands containing miniature painted scenes of elephants, skeletons marching, and ancient cities. Dramatic moody sky, painterly fantasy style with rich detail and atmospheric depth.
